standards_and_prior_work.name: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
verified_points: provenance distinguishes entities, activities, agents, derivations and revisions
the model is domain-agnostic and does not itself determine whether a claimed derivation is true

standards_and_prior_work.name: SWHID Specification v1.2 Core Identifiers
verified_points: content, directory, revision, release and snapshot objects receive intrinsic identifiers
hierarchical identifiers are computed from referenced object identifiers

standards_and_prior_work.name: Trusty URIs: Verifiable, Immutable, and Permanent Digital Artifacts for Linked Data
verified_points: hash-bearing identifiers make immutable artifacts verifiable

standards_and_prior_work.name: RFC 9052 — CBOR Object Signing and Encryption
RFC 9943 — SCITT Architecture
verified_points: Signed Statements bind issuer, subject and payload
transparency registration does not establish content truth

scope_limit: W3C PROV, SWHID and Trusty URIs establish substantial prior work for provenance, intrinsic identifiers and verifiable reference trees. ACSD v1.6.0 claims only an application-specific executable profile and counterexamples for anonymous scholarly series; all keys, clocks, observations and identities are local fixtures.
